:::{#exm-prediction-rule}
#### A fitted line used to predict <!-- prose-allow: prediction rule -->

Take the line from @exm-fitted-model.
<!-- prose-allow: prediction rule -->
Using it to predict the fuel economy of a car that is not in the `mtcars` [data set](#def-data-set) makes it a prediction rule.
Using it only to describe the cars in the data set makes no prediction,
so there it is a fitted model and not a prediction rule.

:::
